jobs.description:
Client Care Coordinator (Front Desk \& Sales)

**Part\-Time \| Tuesday, Wednesday \& Thursday \| 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM**

**$18/hour \+ Performance Bonuses (up to $600–800/month)**

About ProSkin Medical Spa

ProSkin Medical Spa is a modern and rapidly growing medical aesthetics practice built on European standards of care, advanced technology, and an exceptional client experience.

For over two years, we have been helping clients achieve healthier, more beautiful skin through evidence\-based aesthetic treatments and personalized care. Today, we proudly offer both aesthetic and medical spa services, providing our clients with a comprehensive approach to skin health and beauty.

Our services include professional skincare treatments, HydraFacial®, Geneo X™, advanced facial treatments, injectables, IV therapy, and other modern aesthetic procedures. This fall, we are further expanding our medical spa with the addition of advanced laser technologies.

Our clients value quality, professionalism, personalized care, and long\-term relationships. Every client who walks through our doors should feel welcomed, cared for, and confident they are receiving the highest level of service.

**Our core values:**

**Support • Care • Results**

About the Position

We are looking for a warm, organized, and customer\-focused **Client Care Coordinator** to become the face of our practice.

This role is ideal for someone who genuinely enjoys communicating with people, creating exceptional client experiences, and helping both our clients and our business grow.

As the first and last person every client interacts with, you will play a key role in creating a welcoming, professional, and memorable experience.

Schedule

* Tuesday, Wednesday \& Thursday
* 10:00 AM – 8:00 PM
* Part\-time

* Welcome and check in clients with a friendly and professional attitude
* Deliver an exceptional customer experience from the moment clients arrive
* Answer phone calls, text messages, Instagram DMs, and other client inquiries
* Schedule, reschedule, and confirm appointments
* Maintain accurate client records in our management system
* Process payments and complete client checkout
* Recommend treatment packages, memberships, skincare products, and additional services
* Upsell treatments and retail products based on each client's needs
* Rebook clients before they leave the office
* Coordinate communication between providers and clients
* Keep the reception area clean, organized, and welcoming
* Assist with daily administrative tasks
* Help the team achieve monthly goals for sales, rebooking, and client retention

We're Looking For Someone Who

* Loves working with people and creating outstanding client experiences
* Has excellent spoken and written English
* Knowledge of **Russian and/or Ukrainian** is highly preferred
* Is friendly, positive, organized, and detail\-oriented
* Learns quickly and enjoys working in a fast\-paced environment
* Feels comfortable recommending services and products that genuinely benefit clients
* Is proactive, responsible, and dependable
* Works well as part of a team
* Is looking for a long\-term career rather than just a job
* Shares our values of **Support, Care, and Results**

**Previous experience in a medical spa, aesthetic clinic, beauty industry, hospitality, customer service, front desk, or sales is highly preferred but not required. We are happy to train the right person.**

What We Offer

* **$18 per hour**
* **Performance\-based monthly bonuses (up to $600–800/month)**
* Company\-sponsored education and ongoing professional training
* Career growth opportunities within a rapidly expanding Medical Spa
* Employee discounts on all treatments and professional skincare products
* Team\-building events and company celebrations
* A supportive, positive, and collaborative work environment

Loyalty Rewards

* After **6 months** with the company, you'll receive a **$200 gift card** to enjoy services at Miracle Spa.
* After **1 year** with the company, you'll become eligible for an additional **monthly loyalty bonus** as a thank\-you for your long\-term commitment and contribution to our team.

Why Join ProSkin?

We truly believe that our team is our greatest investment.

We are committed to helping every employee grow professionally, continue learning, build a successful career, and feel genuinely appreciated. We invest in our people because we know that when our team thrives, our clients receive the best possible experience.

If you're looking for more than just a job and want to become part of a supportive, ambitious, and growing company, we'd love to meet you.

**Please send us your resume and tell us why you think you'd be a great fit for our team.**

**THE POSITION**
----------------


This position coordinates various social and recreational activities for the Community Centers programs. The Program Coordinator is responsible for planning, coordinating, and facilitating recreation\-based programs for all ages and abilities that reflect the needs and interests of the surrounding community. This includes youth and teen summer camps, afterschool programs, wellness activities, senior services, special events, and facility operations. The position is also responsible for supervising non\-career\-level staff and providing support for facility operations.

The ideal candidate will have the following knowledge, skills and abilities:  

* Leadership experience in recreational settings, serving participants of all ages and abilities
* Understanding of parks and recreation best practices, including program registration software and operational systems
* Building strong community partnerships with stakeholders, service providers, and local organizations
* Applying person centered enrichment strategies to support individualized experiences within group program environments

  

To coordinate and direct recreation, educational enrichment, child care, special events, or other special community programs and activities in a facility or site, or to coordinate and direct a City\-wide program or service in a special programming area.  

  

SUPERVISION RECEIVED AND EXERCISED  

  

Direction is provided by a higher\-level professional or management position. Responsibilities may include the direct or indirect supervision of lower\-level positions.

-----------------------------------------


*The following duties are typical for this classification. Incumbents may not perform all the listed duties and/or may be required to perform related duties as needed:*

* Coordinate departmental activities with related activities of other departments or outside agencies and groups.

* Provide workshop instruction and in\-service training for lower\-level staff.
* Prepare and maintain written reports, records, and memorandums related to assigned programs or facilities.
* Prepare and compile materials for obtaining grant funds.
* Coordinate and conduct part\-time and seasonal recruitments.
* Make oral presentations to various groups and/or boards.
* Develop and coordinate fund\-raising events.
* Supervise recreation leaders, volunteers, and other assigned personnel in activities.

* Respond to inquiries from the public and other agencies.
* Interview, select, evaluate, and oversee participants and activities related to the program.
* Perform related duties as required.

* Principles of supervision and training.
* First aid and safety practices.
* English usage, spelling, grammar, and punctuation. Common computer software packages.
* Organization, procedures, and operating details of the department.
* Facilities, equipment, and staffing needed to provide recreation, educational enrichment, child care, special events, or special community services to the community.

* Establish and maintain cooperative relationships with those contacted in the course of work.

* Express and relate ideas clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing.

**POSITION SUMMARY**


Under the direction of the Manager of Housing Based Support Services, the ICMS Case Manager will be responsible for providing coordinated Case Management and Supportive Services for formerly homeless individuals diagnosed with special needs. The ICMS Case Manager will deliver services on\-site to tenants who reside at our newly developed multi\-unit permanent supportive housing complex. The Case Manager will also help link clients to services which include but not limited to life skills workshops, money management, educational attainment, access to health services, counseling, job training and placement opportunities and resident activity coordination

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES \& RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Work with each tenant to conduct an initial housing intake and needs assessment
* Assist tenants in determining personal goals and plans to achieve such goals through the development of the Individual Service Plan (ISP)
* Work with any pre\-existing conditions and/or obstacles for clients to facilitate all housing related processes being completed in a timely fashion.
* Conduct a minimum of two face\-to\-face contacts with each tenant monthly
* Conduct quarterly meetings with each tenant to discuss tenant’s progress and accomplishments as evidenced by Individualized Stability Plans
* Act as a liaison among the Property Manager, the property management company, the tenant, and the primary mental health provider to facilitate the communication of concerns that could jeopardize the tenant’s residency
* Provide information and instruction to clients regarding Fair Housing, tenant rights and responsibilities, observation of rental agreement and property rules
* Act as a liaison and coordinate linkage to services with numerous public social service agencies and community providers, assist in achieving and sustaining independence: employment and education/ training activities, money management counseling and legal and benefits counseling
* Assist clients in obtaining rental assistance: move\-in/eviction prevention services
* Address tenant grievances, mediate resident disputes and resolve any issues with property management that might affect the client’s tenancy
* Enforce housing rules in collaboration with property management
* Work with Resident Services Coordinator to develop workshop opportunities on relevant topics including housekeeping, money management, parenting, daily living skills (including transportation, training in self\-advocacy/community accessibility) needed to maintain housing and achieve independence
* Data collection/entry into DHS CHAMP’s database to document client progress, assemble reports and evaluate program
* Organization and management of client files
* Monitor status of tenants who have moved into housing and prepare tenants who are deemed ready to transition to mainstream non\-supportive housing
* Comply with the directives as it relates to necessary documentation and reporting requirements as per the service contract
* Compile and submit monthly progress reports to track the tenants’ residency status and the supportive services which have been provided to them
* Uphold CRCD’s Mission Statement and 5 Year Strategic Plan
